title: dedicated-autoscaler-burst-controls-util-reporting-v24
author: Ava Martinez
description: Motivation: this PR fixes an edge case in the Dedicated fleet autoscaler where short high-concurrency bursts could trample reserved capacity and generate spurious scale-ups, causing cost and latency regressions. The change consolidates burst-window accounting, tightens soft/ hard burst limits, and exports additional per-fleet utilization metrics to improve observability and alerting. Changes include: controller logic to prefer reserve capacity for short bursts, new burst_smoothing policy, metrics for burst_violation_count and burst_duration_ms, a config schema bump (v2 -> v3) with migration code, and dashboard + alert rules. Checklist: - [x] Controller algorithm and unit tests - [x] Backwards-compatible config migration path - [x] Metrics + Prometheus export - [x] Integration tests against simulator harness - [x] Docs + changelog entry - [x] SRE review Context and links: related Linear tasks ENG-4219 ENG-4302, previous iterations pr-162120 and pr-1502345. Impact: behavior is backwards-compatible for default configs but operators may opt into the stricter burst_smoothing policy. Follow-ups: expose per-tenant burst history via Console and add rate-limited mitigation for noisy tenants.
